hero.subtitle: An agentic AI system that turns sales data into Instagram schedules with post concepts and copy.

landing.problem: Restaurant marketers and agencies still rely on gut feel to decide what to promote. That leads to missed demand signals, wasted budget, and underperforming campaigns.
landing.solution: Menuyukti turns sales data into marketing intelligence and AI workflows that create Instagram schedules with post concepts and copy, then measures the real impact of those posts.

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: Marketing agents that transform sales data into actionable insights.

items.top_items: The menu items with the highest demand or strongest performance in the selected analysis context.
items.peak_hours: The hourly windows where demand is highest and audience attention is most concentrated.
items.weekday_bias: A directional signal showing whether demand is stronger on weekdays or weekends.
items.daypart_demand_distribution: Relative demand split across dayparts (morning, lunch, afternoon, evening).
items.weekday_demand_distribution: Relative demand split across days of the week.
items.audience_intent_clusters: Behavior-based groupings of customer intent inferred from ordering patterns.
items.party_size_signal: A derived indicator of likely order context (solo, pair, or group) from basket behavior.
items.social_dining_probability: An estimate of how likely orders are associated with shared or social consumption.
items.audience_mix_summary: A concise summary of dominant audience behavior segments in the selected dataset.
items.analysis_window: The effective time range of data used to compute the audience outputs.
items.popularity_index_summary: A summary of item popularity scores used to detect preference concentration.
items.top_item_revenue_share: The share of total revenue contributed by top-performing menu items.
items.category_mix: The relative demand or revenue contribution of each menu category.
items.tone_profile: The overall voice and personality to apply across Instagram posts and reels.
items.language_guidelines: Rules for language choice, tone, and readability for your audience.
items.caption_style: Recommended structure and style for Instagram captions.
items.hashtag_style: Guidelines for hashtag selection, volume, and mix.
items.content_dos_donts: Content do's and don'ts to keep posts on-brand and effective.
items.post_concepts: Short concepts or themes to shape upcoming Instagram posts.
items.cta_phrases: Suggested call-to-action phrases aligned with the audience.
items.emoji_guidelines: Emoji usage guidance to match tone without overusing.

chat.milestone1PassCriteria:
Trade area and peak hours are documented with sources or assumptions called out.
Guest segments are named with at least one supporting signal (sales, reviews, or staff input).
Site positioning, hero menu items, and hard constraints (hours, brand, compliance) are explicit.
Profile is factual enough for downstream audience and offer recommendations.
chat.milestone1Input: Paste notes from your GM or link to your last menu refresh…
chat.milestone1ResultMarkdown:
## Location profile (draft)

**Trade area:** 12–15 min drive around the site; lunch office crowd Tue–Thu.

**Segments:** power lunch (35%), families weekend (28%), delivery dinner (22%).

**Constraints:** kitchen closes 9:30pm; no alcohol promos without manager approval.
chat.milestone2PassCriteria:
Objectives are measurable (reach, visits, or revenue) and time-bound.
Primary audience ties back to the location profile segments.
!Primary audience is still too broad — narrow to one segment (example not met).
?Key messages, channels, and timing fit the brand and local context (pending validation).
?Campaign budget split and channel mix under review (pending).
?Stakeholders who must approve are listed or implied (pending confirmation).
chat.milestone2Input: Optional: objectives, promos already approved, dates to avoid…
chat.milestone2ResultMarkdown:
## Campaign brief

**Goal:** lift weekday lunch covers by 8% over 4 weeks.

**Audience:** office workers within 10 minutes, Tue–Thu 11:30–1:30.

**Messages:** speed of service, chef’s lunch set, loyalty nudge.

**Channels:** Instagram feed + Stories; in-store QR to follow.
